bio: A shrewd and industrious merchant-baker who has risen from humble beginnings through relentless ambition and keen business acumen. Ludovico operates multiple enterprises across Venice with the calculating precision of a seasoned trader, yet his obsessive pursuit of profit often blinds him to the personal costs of his ventures.
